Summary.en: Validates the field value and/or the individual keystrokes against regular expressions.
Summary.de: Validiert den Feldwert und/oder die einzelnen Tastenanschläge anhand regulärer Ausdrücke.
Summary.it: Convalida il valore del campo e/o i singoli tasti tramite espressioni regolari.

Parameter.Expression: The regular expression the value of the field has to comply to. Use '°' instead of '^' to mark the beginning of the input string or a negation.
Parameter.KeyExpression: The regular expression the individual keystrokes have to comply to.
Parameter.Flags: The regular expression flags used to create the Expression (defaults to 'g').
Parameter.KeyFlags: The regular expression flags used to create the KeyExpression (defaults to 'g').
Parameter.ErrorPrefix: The first part of the error message displayed prior to the Expression.
Parameter.ErrorPostfix: The final part of the error message displayed after the Expression.
Parameter.ExposeExpression: Will expose the Expression within the error message if set to TRUE (case insensitive).

Expression.default: The regular expression the value of the field has to comply to. Use '°' instead of '^' to mark the beginning of the input string or a negation.

KeyExpression.default: The regular expression the individual keystrokes have to comply to.

ErrorPrefix.default: The first part of the error message displayed prior to the Expression.

ErrorPostfix.default: The final part of the error message displayed after the Expression.

ExposeExpression.default: will expose the expression within the error message if set to true (case insensitive).
